title: EvaluatorResult record
description: I/O contract §2, EvaluatorResult: "evaluator name and version, model version, input projection digest, result, probabilities, status, routing consequence, later assessed outcome"; fields per Appendix A. An evaluator may defer a wake, never drop it (§4; D9).

status.description: `ok` is Appendix A's and `uncertain`, `unavailable`, `invalid` follow §5's triage fallbacks; `timeout` is Odin's provisional addition in I0 (§5 says only that a timeout must not leave work waiting for a report).

consequence.description: `deferred` is documented (Appendix A); `baseline` and `none` are Odin's provisional additions in I0.
